standard_conditions: Item is unworn and unwashed with original tags attached.
Refund goes to the original payment method; exchanges for another size are free.

exceptions.rule: Defective on arrival: if the customer reported the defect within 7 days of delivery, the item can be returned for replacement or refund up to 90 days after delivery. Requires human approval.

not_returnable: Underwear and swimwear with the hygiene seal removed.

standard_conditions: Item is unused and in its original packaging.
Refund goes to the original payment method.

exceptions.rule: Damaged or defective on arrival: if the customer reported the damage within 7 days of delivery (support ticket, email, or chat), the item can be returned for replacement or refund up to 90 days after delivery. Requires human approval.
Failures after use are handled as manufacturer warranty claims, not returns. Offer to open a warranty claim instead of a refund.

not_returnable: Fuel canisters and other hazardous materials once shipped.
